fusions.name: Spadeful of Loam
fusions.desc: Flings a clod of rotting loam that deals 14 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds. It leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Graveside Puffballs
fusions.desc: Primes up to 3 bodies within 9 tiles. Each bursts for 20 damage the moment an enemy comes near it, and the burst reaches 3.5 tiles. It deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Heaped Mound
fusions.desc: Heaps a wall of earth 4 tiles long for 10 seconds. Nothing crosses it. You regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Fertile Ground
fusions.desc: When you gain health, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 15 seconds.
